scope_note: Publicly observable company-page and company-owned social presence snapshot. This file is not a direct social-platform API feed and must not be represented as real-time or automated social listening.

platform_status.detail: Company pages and recent public updates can be reviewed on the open web, but competitor organization-post retrieval is not connected as an approved daily API feed in this repository.
Public company video channels and video libraries can be verified, but the repository does not currently contain a configured YouTube Data API key or approved daily connector.
No X API application, bearer token or usage credits are configured in this repository, so automated post monitoring is unavailable.
No approved Meta application or Page access credentials are configured for automated competitive content monitoring.
No approved Meta application or Instagram access credentials are configured for automated competitive content monitoring.

companies.name: Quest Diagnostics
companies.narrative: Broad diagnostic-access, innovation and community-health narrative, with visible emphasis on genomics, oncology workflow integration and health equity.
companies.format_signal: Mix of clinical education, corporate storytelling and partnership announcements

companies.name: Labcorp
companies.narrative: High-volume professional narrative around precision oncology, consumer genetics, colorectal screening and evidence-led testing innovation.
companies.format_signal: Product education, Q&A content and science-led launch communications

companies.name: ARUP Laboratories
companies.narrative: Specialist educational positioning led by laboratory medicine, rare disease, stewardship and practical implementation of new diagnostics and AI.
companies.format_signal: Expert education, conference amplification and specialist laboratory content

companies.name: Mayo Clinic Laboratories
companies.narrative: Premium clinical-authority narrative built on specialty testing, subspecialist expertise and high-complexity diagnostic education.
companies.format_signal: Frequent educational updates and specialist test explainers

companies.name: BioReference Health
companies.narrative: Service and scientific-excellence positioning with emphasis on core clinical diagnostics, women’s health and tailored testing solutions.
companies.format_signal: Lower observed public cadence; brand and service positioning dominates

companies.name: Sonic Healthcare USA
companies.narrative: Regional-network and employer-brand narrative, increasingly supported by strategic-partnership and healthcare-innovation messaging.
companies.format_signal: Employer branding plus partnership and operational-service storytelling

companies.name: Cleveland Clinic Laboratories
companies.narrative: Laboratory perception benefits from the parent Cleveland Clinic authority halo; public content is predominantly patient education, research and specialty-care leadership rather than laboratory-only promotion.
companies.format_signal: High-volume parent-brand education; laboratory-specific attribution is limited

companies.name: NeoGenomics Laboratories
companies.narrative: Highly focused oncology narrative around companion diagnostics, MRD, population-scale cancer data and personalized treatment decisions.

executive_insights.title: Professional social is the clearest competitive battleground
executive_insights.detail: The strongest observable competitor signals are concentrated on LinkedIn, where Labcorp has the largest public audience in this peer set and Quest has a substantial but smaller corporate following.

executive_insights.title: Clinical authority beats generic corporate volume
executive_insights.detail: Mayo Clinic Laboratories and ARUP use specialist education to build credibility with clinicians and laboratory leaders; this is a different strategic role from broad consumer reach.

executive_insights.title: Oncology and genomics are increasingly narrative-dense
executive_insights.detail: Labcorp, Quest and NeoGenomics are all visibly using precision oncology, genetics, MRD or companion-diagnostic themes, making differentiation in evidence quality and workflow integration more important.

executive_insights.title: Video should be treated as a trust and education channel
executive_insights.detail: Healthcare benchmark research and public company channels reinforce the value of educational video, but the current platform should not claim YouTube performance metrics until an approved connector is configured.
